response.sql: WITH mix_counts AS (SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, COUNT(*) AS mix_count FROM advancedbehavior AS a JOIN transactionrecord AS t ON a.translink = t.transreg GROUP BY t.ordertypedist), mix_shares AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, 1.0 * mix_count / SUM(mix_count) OVER () AS share FROM mix_counts), compared AS (SELECT mix, mix_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM mix_shares) SELECT mix, mix_count, share, share - average_share AS above_average_share FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
